statements: ALTER TABLE pc_artifact_processing_binding_states ADD COLUMN plugin_id VARCHAR(128), ADD COLUMN plugin_family VARCHAR(128), ADD COLUMN plugin_spec JSON, ADD COLUMN binding_generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', ADD COLUMN desired_state VARCHAR(16), ADD COLUMN phase VARCHAR(16), ADD COLUMN last_error VARCHAR(1024)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_family_schemas (
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	declaration JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (family, schema_version)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_vector_spaces (
	space_id VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	profile_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	profile_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	dimension INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	distance VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	normalization VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	storage_format_version VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	backend VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	physical_table VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	provision_state VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (space_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_artifact_vector_space UNIQUE (backend, profile_fingerprint, storage_format_version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_vector_dimension CHECK (dimension > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_vector_indexes (
	index_def_id VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	index_name VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	projection_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	source_kind VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	projection_spec JSON NOT NULL, 
	definition_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (index_def_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_artifact_index_definition UNIQUE (family, index_name, schema_version, projection_version, space_id, definition_fingerprint), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES pc_artifact_vector_spaces (space_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family, schema_version) REFERENCES pc_artifact_family_schemas (family, schema_version)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_search_states (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	build_id VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	manifest JSON NOT NULL, 
	cleanup_targets JSON NOT NULL, 
	validation_token VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	start_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	applied_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	change_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_index_coverage (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	build_id VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	index_def_id VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	fragment_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	projection_input_hash VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	governance_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, build_id, index_def_id, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family) REFERENCES pc_artifact_search_states (scope_id, family), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_index_fragment_count CHECK (fragment_count >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_index_changes (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	seq BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER, 
	operation VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	governance_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, seq), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family) REFERENCES pc_artifact_search_states (scope_id, family)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_search_text (
	text_id VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	index_def_id VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	build_id VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	fragment_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	fragment_locator TEXT NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	governance_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	searchable_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (text_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_artifact_search_text_fragment UNIQUE (build_id, index_def_id, artifact_id, fragment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family) REFERENCES pc_artifact_search_states (scope_id, family)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_artifact_search_text_search ON pc_artifact_search_text (scope_id, family, build_id, index_def_id, artifact_id)
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ix_pc_artifact_search_fts ON pc_artifact_search_text (searchable_text) WITH PARSER SPACE
